info.title: WeekGlass Sync API v1
info.description: WeekGlass authentication, account lifecycle and calendar synchronization. Hosted calendar access requires active service coverage; self-hosted synchronization is free. Where configured, official hosted plans use one-time WeChat payment through Waffo.

Entitlements.description: Self-hosted bypasses billing, not authentication or quotas. Hosted sync_read and sync_write both require active continuous service coverage from paid periods and/or an explicit administrator grant. current_period_end is the end of that coverage when active and the latest actual coverage end when expired. Prior immutable batch receipts remain available for recovery. An expired account's export_allowed describes the one-time web export allowance; /v1/exports/calendar still requires active service. No automatic data deletion is scheduled.

Event.description: Full replacement of event content, including explicit nulls. Materialized weekly/monthly occurrences retain series_id; no server-side recurrence expansion. version is source local content metadata, NOT remote revision. Live payload only; deletions are mutation.operation=delete. Existing legacy all-day fields remain transport-compatible, without adding UI. Compact serialized UTF-8 Event JSON, including necessary escaping, must not exceed 131072 bytes; validate before transaction. Empty title is valid.

BatchRequest.description: All-or-nothing bounded transaction. Unique event_id and mutation_id within batch. Authenticated device must match. At most 100 mutations and 2097152 bytes of decoded UTF-8 JSON. Validate byte/count limits before any write transaction. Larger logical series operations require explicitly tracked deterministic batches with visible partial progress; never silently split an already-sent batch.

committed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. Client timestamps are descriptive, never conflict authority.

Receipt.description: Persisted receipt replayed unchanged for identical batch. commit_cursor is only a catch-up hint: NEVER advance the client pull cursor from this acknowledgement. request_sha256 is SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonicalized request JSON, computed by the server. Authenticate ownership/revocation and scope first, then replay a committed receipt before enforcing write subscription/quota; replay is a read operation.

committed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. Client timestamps are descriptive, never conflict authority.

ChangeBatch.description: One committed atomic batch, never split across pages. Client applies/stages all records and cursor in one local transaction.

server_time.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. Client timestamps are descriptive, never conflict authority.

sleep_schedule.description: Present only for a changed requested sleep_revision. Null means the cloud has no explicit schedule; absent means unchanged or unsupported.

ChangePage.description: Strictly after request cursor. next_cursor acknowledges only included committed batches, or unchanged input if empty. A cursor from another account/server/epoch is never accepted.

SleepSchedule.description: Local wall-clock minutes, with no time zone conversion. Sleep and wake cannot match. If enabled, the visible interval from wake to sleep is at least 15 minutes.

write_id.description: ID of the write which produced this head.

SleepScheduleWrite.description: Requires a matching base revision. Freeze the write ID and body before sending; after a lost response, read the current head before retrying the same write.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. Client timestamps are descriptive, never conflict authority.

SnapshotPage.description: Immutable materialized snapshot from one repeatable-read MVCC boundary serialized by the account state row lock; retry serialization failure. Includes compact tombstone heads. Same boundary on all pages, 900-second TTL, at most one active snapshot per account. Stage pages before atomic local installation; preserve local outbox and fetch changes after boundary only after completion. Stop before 2097152 UTF-8 serialized bytes even if fewer than 500 complete records; never split a record. Reuse the same unexpired account snapshot and remaining TTL for another device/create request; do not invalidate a snapshot already being read.

Ack.description: Acknowledges locally committed pull progress only; not permission to discard local outbox.

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. Client timestamps are descriptive, never conflict authority.

Export.description: Streaming application/json export at one consistent boundary; excludes credentials, tokens, billing details and school browser sessions.

expected_checkout_id.description: Continue only this existing order; never reserve a replacement.

Checkout.description: The server locks the price, currency, period and terms for the selected plan. Optional terms_version is a quote precondition. When continuing an existing order, its stored quote is authoritative. return_uri is only a UI hint and never authorizes payment or redirects the provider.

anyOf.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. Client timestamps are descriptive, never conflict authority.

CheckoutSession.description: Hosted official HTTPS order page with short-lived one-use #ticket fragment. The same account/key/intent always identifies the same order; a still-pending order can issue another ticket. url and expires_at are both null when the order is no longer payable. Neither an opened page nor a browser return grants entitlement.

effective_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z. Client timestamps are descriptive, never conflict authority.

WebhookEvent.description: Normalized INTERNAL event, never a public client request. Exact provider webhook schema/signature verification is implemented only after provider choice.

new_password.description: 8 to 128 characters using at least two of letters, decimal digits, and punctuation/symbols for email-created accounts (whitespace is not a special character); 16 to 1024 for legacy username accounts.

confirmation.description: The account profile username: the original username (up to 80 characters), the backup username while email is unverified, or the current verified email for an email-created account.

username.description: The original WeekGlass username, or the backup username while a new email account is unverified, or the currently verified email.

verified_email.description: Present only after this mailbox has been verified for the account.

pending_email.description: Unverified address currently on this account. A pending address does not prove mailbox ownership.

backup_username.description: Stable username sign-in option for an email-created account if its pending email is unavailable.

email_verification_required.description: A retained confirmed Waffo payment is on file and the account has not verified an email. This is an account-security next step, not a condition of purchased sync access.

email_verification_available.description: The suggested verification can be completed now because this server has mail configured.

CheckoutHandoff.description: Single-use, short-lived order ticket; not an account credential.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor currency units (fen for CNY).

period_seconds.description: Fixed 30 or 365 days of 24 hours each. The 365-day plan is single-purchase only.

BillingSubscription.description: Agreement status and paid calendar coverage are independent. An in-flight order remains visible after cancellation; next_charge_at is present only for an eligible scheduled renewal.

x-weekglass-invariants: All authenticated lookups scope by account from token, never request-controlled account IDs.
Same account counter row lock serializes commits; do not use a PostgreSQL sequence alone as committed cursor.
Push receipts do not advance pull cursor.
Current event heads, including compact tombstone heads and idempotency digests, survive delta-log GC.
Inactive hosted accounts cannot upload new batches, download snapshots or deltas, or acknowledge cursors. Long polls recheck entitlement.
Official hosted Waffo plans are CNY WeChat single purchases. Checkout and event intake are configured separately; existing grants and confirmed paid periods are independent of both switches.
